name: EPIC 220238977
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 8.9 solar radii and 0.87 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,848 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.87 solar masses and 8.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,749 K at its surface.
